sections.text: The northbound connector to northbound SR-133 /in Irvine/ (Orange Co) is closed from 2200 hrs on 9/18/26 to 0600 hrs on 9/19/26 - Due to construction - Motorists are advised to use an alternate route A high wind advisory is in effect from the Jct of SR-126 to the Los Angeles/Kern Co Line - Travel is not recommended for campers, trailers, or permit loads
A high wind advisory is in effect from the Jct of I-580 to the Jct of I-205 (San Joaquin Co) - Travel is not recommended for campers, trailers, or permit loads
A high wind advisory is in effect from the Stanislaus/San Joaquin Co Line to the San Joaquin/Sacramento Co Line - Travel is not recommended for campers, trailers, or permit loads
